name: claudeconnect
notes: A new look, almost exactly like ChatGPT today, light and dark, colours included.
Show more on the update screen no longer flickers while an update runs.
Every effort level is in the picker for every model, Haiku included, plus Ultracode: extra-high effort that splits big tasks across many agents working at once.

Setup has its own small window instead of questions in the terminal, with step-by-step help for turning on Cloudflare Access. Cloudflare asks for a card to turn on Zero Trust: pick the Free plan. It's never charged; the card only checks you're a real person.

The free plan works again. The desktop app no longer lets programs in through a debugging connection, so your site now uses it the way a screen reader does, through your computer's accessibility features. On a Mac, setup asks for the Accessibility permission once.

Whenever it's using the desktop app, a Stop bar sits at the top of your screen, over every window. Press Stop and it lets go at once, and it doesn't touch the app again until you allow it on the site.

The free plan needs the desktop app, on macOS or Windows: there's no browser to fall back on any more. Setup explains that using it this way is automation of your claude.ai account, which Anthropic's terms may not allow, and asks before going on.
When the desktop app asks something, the site shows what it says and its buttons, to answer from any device.
The site, setup and messages now call the assistant by your site's name.
